episodes.title: Everest Returns
episodes.summary: Yi, Jin and Peng discover that Yi's violin has attracted a magical bird-like creature, Fenghuang.

episodes.title: Welcome Home, Everest!
episodes.summary: Yi and the crew notice that Everest isn't looking great, so they try everything to cool him down.

episodes.title: Sewer Koi and the Museum Heist
episodes.summary: A rumble signals the arrival of a new creature; the crew discovers a massive Sewer Koi.

episodes.title: Peng vs. Peng
episodes.summary: After a late-night sugar binge from Nai Nai's stash, Peng starts acting strangely.

episodes.title: Jin's New Look
episodes.summary: Jin proudly dons his new doctor's coat, unwittingly drawing the attention of a creature.

episodes.title: A Cabbage Kinda Day
episodes.summary: Yi discovers one of Morty's babies and attempts to juggle her various responsibilities.

episodes.title: Yeti Superstitious
episodes.summary: Peng learns from Nai Nai that it is his "big bad" year on the zodiac calendar, which means bad luck.

episodes.title: Toad-al Recall
episodes.summary: A wish-granting toad drops into Yi and the crew's lives and becomes weak after granting many wishes.

episodes.title: Chinese Nian Year Part 1
episodes.summary: Peng and a semi-disguised Everest hit the festive streets, eating and enjoying everything in sight.

episodes.title: Chinese Nian Year Part 2
episodes.summary: Peng and Everest are taken by Nian, the legendary dragon-like creature.

episodes.title: Wu You Gonna Call?
episodes.summary: After the reveal of magical creatures' existence and Yi's magic ability in at the end of Season 1, the city's citizens are unsure how to feel about this new revelation. A popular vlogger sets out to capture viral-worthy footage of creatures and magic.

episodes.title: The Ditch Sitch
episodes.summary: The crew gets their first ping on their new creature-helping app! A dried up jellyfish-type creature has been discovered at a construction site, and the anti-creature contractor wants it GONE.

episodes.title: Tales from the Fox's Tails
episodes.summary: When a mysterious creature keeps stealing people's prized possessions, the crew discovers the Nine-Tailed Fox, a trickster rooted in Chinese lore.

episodes.title: Yi's LiLi-est Fan
episodes.summary: While Everest is going through some typical teenager growing pains, a welcome distraction comes in the form of LiLi, an adorable nine-year-old who's positively obsessed with Yi, Everest, and the crew's pursuits.

episodes.title: Qilin-mania
episodes.summary: Superstar-level mania sets in when the renowned and prosperity-brining creature Qilin appears in front of Yi's building.

episodes.title: Shack Attack
episodes.summary: The crew tracks down the source of the havoc-wreaking robot "Qilin" and winds up trapped by Mr. Lung, the Minticon-using candymaker who disappeared in Season 1.

episodes.title: We Meat Again
episodes.summary: After their intense battle against Mr. Lung, the Creature Brigade disbands, leaving Yi and Everest as the remaining creature helpers.

episodes.title: A Hair-ifying Night
episodes.summary: Our crew heads out of the city to reconnect with nature at a once-popular campsite, now deserted and in ruins owing to the urban legend of Yeren: a huge, hairy man who escaped from clown school as the tale goes.

episodes.title: Please Hold for the Next Representative
episodes.summary: Yi and the crew are overrun with pings from humans who are frustrated by creatures they now live alongside. Just when they think they've solved one issue, another springs up – and then that original one pops up again too!

episodes.title: Please Hold While We Connect You
episodes.summary: In the wake of the previous episode, the magical creatures have all vanished and the world at large has gone gray. Desperate to fix things, the crew travels to the Magical Realm to confront the omniscient Great Watcher.
